title: OFFICIAL COPY: CS402 Computer Networks End-Semester Assessment Schedule
inputText:
=== OFFICIAL COPY FOR STUDENT BULLETIN ===
DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING
End-Semester Assessment Schedule -- Fall 2026
Course: CS402 Computer Networks
Course Coordinator: Dr. Vint Cerf

1. Socket Programming Lab Project Demonstration:
   Date: 2026-11-10
   Time: 09:30 - 13:00
   Venue: Networking Lab 2B
   Requirement: Live demo of TCP chat server and packet capture report.

2. Comprehensive Theory Final Examination:
   Date: 2026-12-08
   Time: 14:00 - 17:00
   Venue: Examination Hall A
   Scope: Chapters 1 to 7 (Physical layer through Application layer).
   Admit card mandatory.
===========================================
